name: REVERSE
source:
While visiting her aunt in the coastal town of Port Orford, Oregon, a despondent tiger ends up unwillingly participating in a mysterious game with four other women known as "The Martyr Game", a game with very vague rules. To add on to the fear and confusion, our heroine develops a voice in her head guiding her on how to survive this game. With all this, she must not only trust this voice for survival, but also the other participants in this game.

[From [url=https://mayomilkshake.itch.io/reverse]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在俄勒冈州奥福德港沿海小镇看望她的姨妈时，一只沮丧的老虎最终不情愿地与其他四名妇女一起参加了一场名为“烈士游戏”的神秘游戏，这是一种规则非常模糊的游戏。为了增加恐惧和困惑，我们的女主角在她的脑海中形成了一个声音，指导她如何在这场游戏中生存。有了这一切，她不仅要相信这个声音才能生存，还要相信这个游戏的其他参与者。

[来自[url=https://mayomilkshake.itch.io/reverse]Itch.io[/url]]
